interface Config {
  width: number;
}

interface Batch {
  items: number[];
  width: number;
}

type Operation = (item: number) => Promise<void>;

const width = 1;

async function mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  for (let offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    await Promise.all(items.slice(offset, offset + width).map(operation));
  }
}

async function importAll(items: number[], config: Config, operation: Operation) {
  const { width } = config;
  await mapLimit(items, width, operation);
}

async function exportAll({ items, width }: Batch, operation: Operation) {
  await mapLimit(items, width, operation);
}

async function main() {
  let active = 0;
  let peak = 0;
  let completed = 0;
  const operation: Operation = async () => {
    active++;
    peak = Math.max(peak, active);
    await Promise.resolve();
    active--;
    completed++;
  };
  const items = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, index) => index);
  await importAll(items, { width: 4 }, operation);
  const first = { peak, completed };
  peak = 0;
  completed = 0;
  await exportAll({ items, width: 4 }, operation);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ serialDefault: width, importAll: first, exportAll: { peak, completed } }));
}
main();
